notes.title: Build 0.310 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I hope you're having a great start to your week!  This is a quick new build to fix an issue with our last patch.

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused one character to display as a white square instead of loading their assets properly.
[/list]

- Sad Panda Programmer

notes.title: Release 0.309 - Spring has Sprung
notes.notes:
Hey Panda Peeps!

Long time no flirt! We wanted to let you in on some Hush Hush updates, plus draw your attention to the sweet sale that’s currently happening. Up until March 23, the Hush Hush base game and all its DLC (that includes the gorgeous Artbook and the OST) are 15% off! What a wonderful time to snatch up a little treat for yourself.

In terms of updates, we’ve been busy fixing bugs and polishing things to a high shine. Here’s a list of what we’ve done:

[list]
[*] Switched to using a new controller input system, which enables support for both touch screen and controllers
[*] Fixed several controller issues (thanks to everyone who reported bugs!)
[*] Placed a delay between successive ‘toasts' when an achievement is earned
[*] Fixed a bug where it was impossible to earn a perfect score when taking Elle on her fourth date
[*] Fixed several audio lines
[*] Added a tip to the phone message screen that suggests it is possible to tap the screen to speed up messages
[*] Made adjustments to Iro’s chapter 5 scene
[/list]

We hope these changes will further improve your gaming experience. As always, keep letting us know what you think!

We love you so hard,

The Pandas

notes.title: Patch Notes for 0.288
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Happy Friday!  We're here with a patch for Hush Hush just in time for the weekend.  We hope you enjoy checking out the latest content!  Here's what has changed since the last build:

[list]
[*] Added new phone flings from Cassie, Elle, Iro and Mio that give some additional context to their death scenes
[*] Added a few missing font characters that were using a fallback font
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the game over screen to not get awarded to the gallery
[*] Added some missing entries to the credits
[*] Added an indicator on save files to indicate whether a DLC was used when saving
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the gameover hint to be missing for one of Quill's death scenes
[*] Fixed several typos
[/list]

Thanks again for trying out Hush Hush, and we hope you have a great weekend!

- Sad Panda Programmer

notes.title: Patch Notes for 0.284
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We're here with another batch of fixes for Hush Hush, hopefully squashing a few of those bugs that have been lingering.  Here's what we've been up to this last week:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause some scenes to not reload properly if you reload them from within that same scene (for example, you're in Mio's first date and then you decide to load a save file that is also in the middle of Mio's first date)
[*] Disabled the save/load button while in the middle of running a job or skill
[*] Fixed the 'Like a Virgin', 'Wreathed in Light' and 'The Shadow's Embrace'  in-game achievements
[*] Imported new Lilianna assets for Mio's second date
[*] Fixed a few typos and voiceover issues
[/list]

Thanks for trying out our early access build of Hush Hush, and please let us know if you run into any bugs!  Cheers,

- Sad Panda Programmer

notes.title: Patch Notes for 0.280
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I hope you're having a great week!  We have a new build with lots of content, and we hope you enjoy trying it out!  Thanks to everyone for submitting your bug reports and helping us make this game even better!

Here's a list of what changed with this build:

[list]
[*] Added achievement counts to the top of the achievement page
[*] Modifications to achievements page such as spacing and raycasting
[*] Extend support for animations to the Gallery (may be useful for future or other content)
[*] Allow key bindings to be disabled via the settings popup
[*] Add additional save slots
[*] Fixed up several audio files and typos
[*] Fixed a few in-game achievements that were impossible to earn
[*] Fixed issue with some Fumi death scenes that were causing the background to swap to an unrelated death scene
[*] Large changes to Bonnibel's second date and Elle's fourth date
[*] Fixed a few dates where it was impossible to earn an A+ in some situations
[/list]

Thanks again for playing Hush Hush!

- Sad Panda Programmer

notes.title: Patch Notes for 0.274
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!  I hope you're having a great week so far.  I'm here with a new build and the latest patch notes, we really hope you enjoy the changes!

[list]
[*] Added a few keyboard shortcuts at the request of the community (tab will 'skip' just like pressing the 'skip' button, left control will skip while it is held down)
[*] Added 3 different difficulty modes, which can be selected after starting a new game.  Note:  Any existing old saves will assume the hard difficult mode.  We've also added 3 new in-game achievements and Steam achievements for these different modes.
[*] Added a prompt before loading a save to avoid any misclicks
[*] Fixed several typos and incorrect audio
[*] Reduced the difficulty of the first week
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the next stat to be awarded by the Cafe to be lost when loading a save, resulting in consistent play throughs
[*] Added heart particles to the tutorial
[*] Fixed a bug that would incorrectly show the easter egg text on the date completion dialog in some cases
[/list]

Thanks so much for playing Hush Hush, and please send any bug reports to our support e-mail at support@sadpandastudios.com and we'll do our best to track them down.

Sincerely,

- Sad Panda Programmer

notes.title: 0.266 - Patch Notes Edition!
notes.notes:
Hello!  I'm here to provide some patch notes on what has changed in the game since our initial release version (0.256).  The answer is, we've been hard at work!  Here's a list of what we've done in game so far:

[list]
[*] Fixed multiple issues with the gallery (unlocking or not unlocking when images should have)
[*] Fixed a bug that caused two Steam achievements to not unlock correctly (buff and suave achievements)
[*] Fixed a bug where the effect applied to music/sfx in the settings popup was not resetting properly if the settings popup was closed by opening the gallery
[*] Fixed a bug where an A was awarded instead of an A+ when acing a date
[*] Fixed a bug with Cassie's final date and one option being unavailable
[*] Worked on improving the game memory footprint by unloading unused assets when transitioning to the maps screen
[*] Split assets up to improve loading performance in some cases
[*] Tried to improve loading performance and hangs while loading
[*] Fixed several typos and audio issues
[/list]

We've got more patches in the works, and we'll likely have a new build for you to try out tomorrow.  Thanks so much for playing Hush Hush!

- Sad Panda Programmer
